seo.title: TablePro: native database client for {deviceList}
seo.description: TablePro is a native, open-source database client for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Redis and more. Free to use, with optional paid features.

hero.title: A native database client.
hero.subtitle: Built with each platform’s own toolkit, so it behaves like the rest of your apps.

items.querying: Write SQL with completion from your schema, then run it and read the results below.
items.dataEditing: Edit cells in the grid. Changes wait until you save, and you can discard them.
items.schema: Add and change columns, indexes and foreign keys. Nothing changes until you save.
items.importExport: Export tables and query results to files, and bring CSV and SQL files back in.
items.aiMcp: Ask about your database in a chat, or let your coding agent work with it over MCP.
items.connections: Connect through SSH and TLS, and keep your servers as saved connections.

testimonials.title: What developers say
testimonials.lead: Quoted from public posts, each linked to the original.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.lead: Free to use, with no trial period. Pro and Team add features, and one license covers {deviceLimit} computers, Mac or Linux.

openSource.title: Open source
openSource.statement: TablePro is open source under the AGPLv3, paid features included.
openSource.funding: The TablePro team builds it, and licenses and sponsors fund the work.
